culture.text: Large employer: about 22,295 people on LinkedIn, mostly in engineering, operations and IT.
Staff mostly studied electrical engineering, electronics or computer science, at schools like TU Eindhoven, TU Delft and Politehnica Bucharest.
Offers online and offline learning programmes to help staff grow their careers.

open.text: NXP Semiconductors N.V. and NXP Semiconductors Netherlands B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Has operations in more than 30 countries.

growth.text: Revenue was $13.205 billion with net profit of $2.787 billion in 2022.
Is pushing into physical AI and sees strong growth in data centre demand.
